thread:
maria: Dropping a concise follow-up from the authz postmortem. Root cause: token-validator stalled GC causing JWKS fetch contention and cascading validation errors. We need concrete owners, cutover windows, and a short verification cadence. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-SEC-13021 created: authz-token-validate spike 2026-03-22 11:12-11:48 UTC. Impact: hosted + some eu-west clusters. Severity: P2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/13021

jamie: I'll own the hotfix to add non-blocking JWKS fetch, cache fallback, and a soft circuit-breaker. Target: staging patch 04/02 EOD, 5% canary 04/03.

alex: I'll own telemetry + alert tuning and audit events. Plan: add jwks_fetch_duration_ms histogram, emit authz.event with fields (tenant, verdict, token_hash_short). Will set alerts to avoid noisy pages. ETA 04/05.

tanya: I'll prepare segmented customer comms (hosted vs dedicated). Hold until canary green.

kevin: ops note 3: for the token-validator service we should also validate service account credentials post-rotation. happy to coordinate verification scripts.

oncall-bot: Canary schedule created: token-validator v2-hotfix -> 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC -> 5% traffic. Auto-rollback if validation error rate > 0.5% over 10m.

devsec-bot: Remediation ticket RDW-SEC-13022: rotate token-validator service account + rotate dependent secrets. Proposed maintenance window 2026-04-06 02:00-03:30 UTC.

maria: I added high-level tasks to the sheet. Please add acceptance criteria and smoke test steps by EOD Mon. Quick summary of owners/dates I put: hotfix (jamie) -> 04/02; telemetry & audit (alex) -> 04/05; rotate service account & secrets (devsec/kevin) -> 04/06; comms (tanya) -> after canary.

jamie: Runbook snippet I'll drop in the sheet (short):
```
if jwks_fetch_duration_ms > 400:
  switch_to_cached_jwks()
  start_exponential_backoff(jwks_fetch)
  emit_metric("authz.jwks.block")
if cached_jwks_age_s > 90:
  escalate("eng-oncall")
```
Full runbook + rollback steps by 04/02.

alex: For audit queries I'll add a saved dashboard. Example quick search to find tenant noise:
```
index=authz.event (verdict=FAIL) | stats count by tenant, error_code
```
This will help separate tenant-induced errors from platform regressions.

kevin: I'll prepare verification scripts to run after secret rotation and add them to the maintenance playbook.

maria: Proposing a short verification cadence: daily synthetic token checks for 7 days after deploy, then weekly for 4 weeks. Also a 20-min sync each Thu for the next 4 weeks to review token metrics and outstanding items. I'll send invites. Please ack in-thread with :eyes: after you fill the sheet.

tanya: :eyes: confirmed. I'll hold comms until canary and runbook are done.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed. Working on patch now.

alex: :eyes: will push PR for telemetry today.

maria: Thanks. If something slips update the sheet and ping me directly.
